This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
geranyl diphosphate
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }

α-pinene
+
diphosphate
Cyclase I of
Salvia officinalis
(sage) gives about equal parts (+)-α-pinene and (+)-
camphene
.
